goal: Verify that a user can create a new account, save a private memo, and navigate the calendar forward to a future month.
instructions: On the 'Create your account' page, enter 'alice' into the 'Username' field and 'SecureP@ss123!' into the 'Password' field, then click the 'Sign up' button.
In the 'Any thoughts...' input box, type 'Personal reminder for the weekend.', click the 'Private' button to set the visibility, and then click the 'Save' button.
Locate the calendar widget currently showing 'June 2026' and click the 'Next month' arrow button twice to advance the view to 'August 2026'.
success_criteria: The user is successfully logged in and the main dashboard displays the calendar view.
The memo 'Personal reminder for the weekend.' appears in the feed with a timestamp of 'now' and is marked as private.
The calendar widget header explicitly displays 'August 2026'.
The previously saved memo remains visible in the feed after navigating to the new month.
